lessons.text: queue dev ai try currently rejects nested queue dev merge-plan attempts as queue_dev_subcommand_not_allowlisted; run merge-plan directly in the sourced shell and record the result as a lesson rather than forcing it through try.

0.18.94 Bob14 vector/database lake patchset and Bob12 missing-item cleanup patchset both produce zero-collision merge-plan results against the 0.18.93 Bob15 base; only README/CHANGELOG/scratchpad need manual review or item-level merge.
After multi-patchset apply, bump QUEUEBASH_VERSION and normalize README/CHANGELOG to the merger output version; patchsets may update changelog without changing queuebash.sh.

Bob12 missing-item cleanup is mostly test-suite reliability work: dynamic listener ports, narrower module/caps isolated roots, and less brittle grep patterns prevent false failures without changing runtime semantics.

timeout cannot directly execute the sourced queue shell function because it is not a standalone executable; for bounded function-backed probes use timeout N bash -lc "cd TREE; export QUEUEBASH_ALLOW_NONINTERACTIVE=1; source ./queuebash.sh; queue ...".
